subject: dplyr access the columns for further processing

messages.author: ba3e21d1b7de7d50
messages.subject: dplyr access the columns for further processing
parts:
Hi,

I am fairly new to dplyr and have one question:

I performed a SQL query:
data <- tbl(con, build_sql("SELECT * FROM something)
The resulting data object has:
data$src        data$select     data$mutate     data$group_by   data$query      
data$from       data$summarise  data$where      data$order_by

wenn I type data in the R console I get:

 
date  amount
1  2010-07-30  860.09
2  2010-08-25 1438.78
...

But how can I save these data entries e.g. in a data.frame for further processing?
E.g. forecast a timeseries ...

Thank you very much for help.

Regards,
Georg
